innovations.imageAlt: marketing idea for part-onwership of supercars
innovations.description: Offering "intelligent supercar ownership" écurie25 is a club that gives members the right to drive fine automobiles for 30-40 days per year. Like NetJets does for privatejets, écurie25 takes care of the costs and trouble associated withoutright ownership; members don't have to worry about depreciation,insurance and servicing. Customers can buy either 300 (GBP 4.500) or 600 (GBP 7.950) pointsper year, which they can trade in for their choice of cars. The'supercars' are divided into three categories: F1, F2 and F3. F2 carsinclude the Porsche Boxster S and the TVR Sagaris. Taking one of theseout for a spin on a weekday in October costs 8 points. A three-dayweekend in August goes for 85 points. F1 cars include the Aston MartinVantage and DB9, Bentley Continental and Ferrari F430 Spider. And forthe acceleration of a lifetime, the most inexpensive F3 class includesBritish-built speed demon Ariel Atom. As described in James Twitchell's Living It Up,people aren't shopping for goods as much as they are for an identity.So it makes complete sense that some consumers are trading ownershipfor partial ownership, and the greater freedom and choice that itbrings.

innovations.title: Multi-purpose knives
innovations.imageAlt: These knives utilizes the flat empty surface of the blade for other functions
innovations.description: Anything but simple, the Basic Knives collection is a design by Caroline Noordijk that brings tons of functionality and increased productivity into the kitchen. Utilizing the flat, empty surface of the blade, Caroline incorporates other kitchen tools into the knife. This eliminates having to switch tools and saves time. Having a peeler, grater, zester, or a measuring spoon in my hand at the same time as the knife would do wonders for speeding up my dinner prep time.

innovations.title: Fiber matchsticks
innovations.imageAlt: matchsticks made out of jute
innovations.description: Crusaders like Uttam Bhai Patil has used environment friendly jute to make pencils and match sticks, an idea when implemented on a large scale could save millions of trees and thereby a large part of our environment. Uttam Bhai Patil had been developing his ideas as far back as 1972, when he made a pencil out of Sorghum (Jowar), a common plant found in the sub-continent. His pencil did not need trees to be felled or forests to be razed. Later, he started experimenting with jute, a material that is easily available in the south and coastal regions of India. in 2005, post his retirement, Uttam Bhai Patil made match sticks out of jute !Though the jute match sticks are yet to go into mass production, friends, relatives and neighbours of this inventor are happy with his home grown variety.This invention may well be worth the scrutiny of the scientific community, as it could be the answer to reducing the use of trees for match sticks, pencils and perhaps even paper !
innovations.function: help to achieve effective use of resources

innovations.title: Jasmine rice in "cold corners" bag
innovations.imageAlt: rice bag with four cold corners for easier handling
innovations.description: 'Boil in the bag' dishes are not usually seen as having much scope for innovation, however Masterfoods in Finland has repackaged its Uncle Ben's World of Rice range in a special bag with four 'cool corners', handy for consumers to hold the bag and open it without burning their fingers. A pack of 4 x 125g bags of Jasmine rice with four "cold corners" which claim to stop fingers from getting burnt when serving.This is an interesting innovation that could eventually be adapted to microwaveable meals, as these are also often too hot to handle straight out of the microwave.

innovations.title: Flavored water for dogs
innovations.imageAlt: flavored water for dogs
innovations.description: Molli's Choice introduces a line of Flavored Water for dogs. The purified and non-carbonated water is free from harmful chlorine and fluoride. It is made with all-natural flavors and retails in the following varieties: Bacon Delight; Original; Beef Tenderloin; Roasted Turkey; and Roasted Chicken. The product contains vitamins and minerals.
innovations.function: make it appeal to more senses

innovations.title: Shear Thickening Fluid (STF)
innovations.imageAlt: Shear Thickening Fluid is a liquid that has the ability to make ballistic fabrics highly resistant to penetration
innovations.description: A new nanotechnology known as Shear Thickening Fluid (STF) created by scientists at ARL and UDTC looks set to provide the next generation of armor. STF has the ability to make ballistic fabrics highly resistant to penetration when impacted by a spike, knife or bullet without compromising their weight, comfort or flexibility. The potential applications of STF include a wide range of products such as body armor, vehicle armor, helmets, gloves and bomb blankets to protect soldiers and law enforcement officials plus myriad industrial safety applications all the way through to protective clothing for motorcyclists. When the first products become available later this year, soldiers can expect to be much safer as the liquid body armor can be used in sleeves and pants, which are not usually protected by ballistic vests because they must stay flexible. Sometimes referred to as "liquid armor," the material is actually a nanotechnology that exists in a flexible, fluid-like state under normal conditions but adopts seemingly rigid qualities and becomes less penetrable when impacted.

innovations.title: Respiratory mask
innovations.imageAlt: This mask can help filter out fine airborne particles
innovations.description: These 3M N95 masks help to filter out fine airborne particles including pollens, dander, mite allergen, mold spores, and microorganisms and their unique, lightweight construction helps you stay cool and comfortable while wearing the mask. The New 3M 8210_PRO "professional grade" provides a softer nosefoam, patented filter media, comfort straps, an adjustable noseclip reduces eyewear fogging and provides a secure seal.

innovations.title: Surround sound headphones
innovations.imageAlt: Each of the headphones' ear cups have four discrete speakers for handling front, center, rear and sub-woofer channels
innovations.description: Enjoy 5.1 Channel Surround Sound without a room full of speakers, with Turtle Beach's new Ear Force Surround Sound headphones. Each of the headphones' ear cups have four discrete speakers for handling front, center, rear and sub-woofer channels, as well as convenient volume controls for front, surround, center and sub woofer. When playing games, these surround sound headphones give you the advantage of hearing your opponents before you see them  and create a more immersive gaming environment. When watching DVDs, these surround sound headphones let you experience home theater quality audio without disturbing family members or neighbors.

innovations.title: Thin hollow wall
innovations.imageAlt: A thin hollow wall uses less bricks and reduces thermal conduction, keeping the house cool
innovations.description: Reducing the quantity of material used and making them less expensive has been possible because of advancement in the understanding of the materials of construction.  Walls, these days, are built intelligently with a hollow space between the inner and the outer layers of the bricks without increasing the thickness of the walls. Quantity of the bricks is substantially reduced. The void in the walls reduces thermal conduction and keeps the house cool. The idea is to optimise the use of the materials and increase the sizes of rooms.

innovations.title: SpreFix:spray on insulation
innovations.imageAlt: SpreFix is a method for spray on insulation for sound absorption, moisture and condensation control, fire protection and thermal insulation
innovations.description: SpreFix is a method for spray on insulation. The material is intended for sound absorption, moisture and condensation control, fire protection and also as thermal insulation.The company is mainly working in the areas of marine (ships, oil platforms etc.), building construction, and train carriages.Two different SpreFix methods: SpreFix G, which is applied with glass wool, intended for sound absorption, moisture and condensation control, and thermal lightweight insulation.Secondly there is SpreFix S, which is applied with rock wool. When, in addition demanding fire protection properties are required, this method should be used.

innovations.title: Sore throat relieving powder
innovations.imageAlt: sore throat relieving powder which dissolves instantly
innovations.description: Relief of irritation, pain, and other symptoms associated with a sore throat are normally assuaged via cough syrup or a throat lozenge. But Soltice Medicine offers up a new spin on ridding this worrisome ailment with its new Ice Taps ! This oral anesthetic comes in the form of a granular powder that dissolves instantly. Intended for consumers aged three and older, this product is available in three refreshing flavors: Coffee Mint, Mountain Menthol and Blueberry Blast.

innovations.title: Egg tells you when it's done
innovations.imageAlt: An egg shell displaying a new thermochromic logo, will become visible when the egg is cooked
innovations.description: Experts at the British Egg Information Service have developed an egg stamped with a special thermochromic logo that becomes visible when the egg is ready. All you need to decide is whether you want your eggs soft, medium or hard-boiled.
innovations.function: incorporate identification marks or change indicators

innovations.title: Heat separates a mobile phone
innovations.imageAlt: Heat applied to a mobile phone will activate the shape memory alloy (SMA) and open the mobile phone cover
innovations.description: Nokia Research Center, together with a student group from Helsinki University of Technology, the Finnish School of Watchmaking and the University of Art and Design Helsinki have developed a process for heat disassembly of portable devices. The idea is to disassemble a mobile phone by a heat-activated mechanism without any contact. By using a centralized heat source like laser heating, the shape memory alloy (SMA) actuator is activated, and the mobile phone covers are opened. The battery, display, printed wiring board (PWB) and mechanical parts are separated and can then be recycled in their material specific recycling processes. The required temperature for the disassembly is 60-150 ºC. If it were lower the phone could dismantle by itself, for instance in a hot car, and if it were higher the plastics would melt. Laser heating is a feasible method due to its speed and precision. However, it requires investment in a proper disassembly line.The heat-activated mechanism is a fast and cheap method if compared to manual dismantling, which takes on average two minutes and costs about 0.3-0.8 , per phone. In the project, the heat-activated disassembly took only two seconds and the only cost is the investment cost in a disassembly line. However, the method still needs to be developed further.

innovations.title: Ultrasonic tourniquet
innovations.imageAlt: ultrasonic tourniquet that can stop life-threatening bleeding during combat
innovations.description:
Ultrasonic tourniquets could stop blood vesselsfrom bleeding out by non-invasively coagulating blood using focusedsound waves. 
Called the Deep Bleeder Acoustic Coagulation (DBAC)program, it aims to create a cuff-like device that wraps around awounded limb. Rather than applying pressure to the wound to stem theflow of blood, the device would use focused beams of ultrasound (soundwaves above the audible frequencies) to non-invasively clot vessels nomatter how deep they are.  Accordingto the Pentagon's Defense Advanced Research Projects Agency (DARPA), these internal bleeding injuries are the leading cause of death forsoldiers in the battlefield.
Theultrasound tourniquet is intended to buy time, so that a medic can getthe patient to a better-equipped medical facility.
 Surroundingtissue may be damaged in the process, since it will be heated close tothe boiling point. But the blood vessels remain functional because "theblood flow in the vessel cools the wall and so protects it.

innovations.title: Easy tear tape
innovations.imageAlt: tape with serrated edges for easy tearing
innovations.description: the original tape with serrated edges, very easy tear by hand strong adhesion ultra transparent

innovations.title: Collapsible eyeglasses
innovations.imageAlt: collapsible eyeglasses
innovations.description: The Optigami is a collapsible eyeglass and self-encasing system which,when folded, creates its own case, offering full protection for thelenses, and is easily carried and stored as a result of its ultra-slimprofile. The name Optigami is derived from the combination of theprefix "Opti" (as in optical) and "origami," the Japanese art offolding paper into shapes such as animals or flowers.

innovations.title: Double balloon whisk
innovations.imageAlt: A smaller ball whisk inside a whisk cut down the whisking time
innovations.description: Cream whipped by hand has a more velvety texture and just tastes better. Any cook with an overdeveloped forearm will appreciate the ingenious design of these Kuhn Rikon whisks. By simply doubling the number of wires, the stainless steel beater cuts down whisking time by half.

innovations.title: Nested measuring cups
innovations.imageAlt: These nested measuring cups fit perfectly inside each other
innovations.description: The three measuring cups nest beautifully into one another allowing a minimal amount of room to be required when stored.Each cup has it own ergonomic handle yet, they all nest into one another.The fitting cover allows a measured ingredient or recipe to be set aside and protected until needed.Ease of reading measurements is accomplished by the slanted sides which allow users to see through to the measuring lines and markings printed on the sides as well as to be read from the outside and the front to read from the inside.The curvature of the sides allows for easy whisking and stirring. This curvature and continuous surfaces provide ease of cleaning, especially since it's dishwasher safe and has no sharp corners to catch ingredients.The aesthetics reflect the purity of form and utility, which create their own beauty of transparency and reflection as they nest as a group.The handles create a waterfall of ripples that nest wonderfully into one another, all while fulfilling ergonomic needs of a hand from the large container to the small.
innovations.function: create a more modular or  stackable component assembly

innovations.title: Bacardi Bespoke bar service
innovations.imageAlt: service that brings bars to customers' homes or offices
innovations.description: Bacardi Bespoke is aservice from Bacardi in the UK that brings bars to customers' homes oroffices. The bars come complete with glasses, ice, equipment, expertcocktail mixologists, a portable bar and a DJ. Naturally, the bartenders make everything with Bacardi, havingcreated new versions of classic cocktails to incorporate Bacardi rum.Cocktail lists are personalised to a host's taste and a party's themeor vibe. In essence small-scale sponsored and branded events, Bespokehome parties are subsidised by Bacardi, so prices aren't as high aswould be expected from a professional service. Spiked with a splash of tryvertising, Bacardi Bespoke is great example of what trendwatching.com has defined as the insperiencetrend: consumers' desire to bring top-level experiences into theirdomestic domain.

innovations.title: Delivery service
innovations.imageAlt: home delivery service that will deliver anything within the hour
innovations.description: Zifty has beenoffering Atlantans fast delivery since 2004. Zifty delivers food,movies, magazines, snacks, and household goods in about an hour, andpartners with restaurants to deliver meals. The company employsdrivers, but keeps costs down by paying them per delivery. All ordershave a delivery fee of USD 0.99, and an additional USD 2.99 is addedfor orders from restaurants. Orders with a subtotal over USD 50 getfree delivery, and those placed more than 2 hours in advance get 50%off the fee. Minimum order size is USD 9.95. Now that everyone's online, and consumers are willing to pay extrato save time and get instant gratification, similar uber-convenienceconcepts are popping up in cities around the world.
innovations.function: increase the customers desire for more of the product

innovations.title: 2 seconds self made tent
innovations.imageAlt: Just throw 2Seconds into the air and it will open up on its own before even reaching the ground
innovations.description: Just throw 2Seconds into the air and it will open up on its own before even reaching the ground. It is the spring hoops that enable this. The idea was to pre-assemble the different elements (room, double roof, hoops) to simplify the hiker's life as much as possible.

innovations.title: E-Rope modular power strip
innovations.imageAlt: modular power strip that enables users to add or subtract sockets as needed
innovations.description: E- rope is a modular power strip that enables users to add or subtractsockets as needed. In addition, to better accommodate large, bulkycords each socket can also be rotated 180 degrees, so adjacent socketsare not blocked. When electrical devices are not in use, simply twistthe socket section 90 degrees to disconnect the flow of electricity.(Often referred to as vampire power, approximately 10 percent of ahome's electricity is used by appliances in standby mode.)
innovations.function: create a more modular or  stackable component assembly

innovations.title: Sugar carton
innovations.imageAlt: sugar carton for easy pouring and built-in transparent measuring gauge
innovations.description: A 750g carton of Extra Fin En Poudre is a new extra fine sugar whichcomes in an airtight carton, said to protect from humidity, to make thesugar easy to pour. The pack will not split easily and includes atransparent measuring gauge.
innovations.function: add ability to make simple measurement

innovations.title: Electromagnetic railgun
innovations.imageAlt: railgun that uses electromagnetism instead of gunpowder
innovations.description: The United States Navy has awarded two contracts for the development ofan electro-magnetic gun system capable of deployment on board navalsurface combatant ships. The development work preliminary design for anElectro-Magnetic (EM) railgun prototype and the preliminary design ofthe U.S Navy's 32 megajoule (MJ) Laboratory Launcher. Anelectro-magnetic railgun uses electrical energy to accelerateprojectiles to extreme velocities. Railguns do not require powders orexplosives to fire the round and therefore free magazine space forother mission areas. In addition, electro-magnetic guns provide ahighly consistent and uniform explosive charge that gives much greateraccuracy. Thirty-two megajoule is equivalent to a firing speed of Mach8 or eight times the speed of sound. This will be an intermediate stepon the road to a 64-MJ Tactical System capable of deployment on-boardnaval surface combatant ships.

innovations.title: Foamed concrete
innovations.imageAlt: foam concrete which is easier to apply and weighs less
innovations.description: READYMIX foamed concrete is a highly workable, low-density material incorporating         up to 50% entrained air. It is generally self-levelling, self-compacting         and may be pumped. Risk of plastic shrinkage or settlement cracking is         significantly lower than that of normal concrete.       Foamed concrete is ideal for filling redundant voids such as disused         fuel tanks, sewer systems, pipelines, and culverts -.particularly where         access is difficult. It is a recognised medium for the reinstatement of         temporary road trenches. Good thermal insulation properties make foamed         concrete also suitable for sub-screeds and filling under-floor voids.      Readymix foamed concrete has an entrained air content typically of between         10-50% -.dependent on production method and dosage. Dry densities are         typically between 800 to 1600 kg/cubic metre. The material typically remains         fluid for 2/3 hours after mixing with the foam (depending upon ambient         conditions).

innovations.title: Flower power
innovations.imageAlt: Large windmills grouped into a flower bouquet
innovations.description:
The Dutch advisory for the landscape asked designers to come up with anew generation wind mills. 100 MW mountains, a cooperation between OneArchitecture, Ton Matton and NL architect, suggested that grouping up to 10 turbines into a kind of flower bouquet would add a nice touch to the landscape.
"Flower arrangement with windmills. Landscape pollution to monumentalstatement. From candleholder to tree, from Eifeltower to St Louis Arch;Energy production turns 'heroic". The Atomium, but productive: FlowerPower!"

innovations.title: Airtrax sidewinder
innovations.imageAlt: fork lift truck that can move in all directions
innovations.description: Airtrax SIDEWINDER industrial lift trucks excel in applications requiring tight maneuvering or transporting long loads sideways trough standard sized doors or narrow aisleways. The SIDEWINDER's unique, Omni-Directional movement allows it to travel in all directions thus making it an ideal vehicle to work in thight spaces where turns are not possible and finite control is a must. The truck features 48 volt transistor controls with state-of-the-art technology, infinitely variable travel, lift and lower speeds, excellent visibility, ergonomic controls and operator comfort

innovations.title: Siemens multimedia cooking hood
innovations.imageAlt: A cooking hood with built-in TV, radio and CD player
innovations.description:
The new multiMedia canopy hood in the clear Siemens design is a visual feast for the eyes and comprises all the elements characteristic of first-class function although operation remains child's play with the electronic control. The extremely high extractor capacity of 650 m³ per hour on the intensive setting, guaranteeing powerful extraction, is a clear benefit even if it is scarcely perceptible to the ear: the multimedia canopy hood is the one of the quietest on the market. And with good reason: after all, hobby and professional chefs do not want to miss the news, sporting events or their favourite programmes while cooking.
The Siemens multiMedia canopy hood steps into the breach with an innovative solution, combining listening and viewing entertainment with good design. Wiring and all technical elements are concealed in the chimney. What remains is the sheer enjoyment of clear contours and perfectly integrated entertainment electronics.
innovations.function: add a new function or integrate another function

innovations.title: Mint full contact spice grinder
innovations.imageAlt: This spice grinder  pestle is shaped to mate the contours of the mortar
innovations.description: This sculptural and highly functional spice grinder brings beauty and elegance to the user's kitchen. The "full contact" nature of the pestle as it mates seamlessly with the mortar improves grinding. And, the porcelain pestle is shaped to nestle comfortably in the palm of your hand, begging the user to interact with the design. The softness of the forms is juxtaposed to the extreme hardness of the fired porcelain, one of the hardest and most durable industrialized materials. The grinder can be found in high-end design stores worldwide, further attesting to its appeal.
innovations.function: create a more modular or  stackable component assembly

innovations.title: No-mow grass
innovations.imageAlt: Scientists have developed a grass that stays short and doesn't need mowing
innovations.description: Scientists who got to the root of a steroid pathway that controls plant height say a perfect green lawn that never needs mowing may soon become a reality. The idea of being able to precisely control plant height might not sound that exciting at first, but ... what if your lawn just couldn't grow into a scraggly forest of grass, staying short and neat without ever needing mowing? Or what if crops could be made to grow larger, producing more food per acre?As plant scientist and Howard Hughes Medical Institute investigator Joanne Chory explains, these aren't fantasies. She and her team at the Salk Institute have clarified the signaling pathway of a class of plant hormones called brassinosteroids that play a central role in regulating plant stature. These steroids are so important in telling plants to grow that disrupting the pathway turns plants into tiny dwarves.

innovations.title: On/Off lamp
innovations.imageAlt: A motion sensor in a lamp creates a new way of turning it on or off, by knocking it from one side to the other
innovations.description: The On/Off Ligh gives you an entirely different way of interacting with it. It's base is cut at a 45 degree angle. On one side, it's on. On the other side, it's off.So, when it's time for bed, simply slap the thing, and off it goes. If, in your overeagerness to slap something, you push it off the night table altogether, you've no reason to worry: it's made from practically indestructible soft thermoplastic.

innovations.title: Shift tricycle
innovations.imageAlt: A bicycle/tricycle with 2 rear wheels that move closer together as the rider picks up speed makes it easier to balance at slower speeds
innovations.description: Industrial designers from Purdue University have invented the Shift tricycle, whose rear wheels move closer together as the rider picks up speed, then separate for easier balance at slower speeds or at a standstill. A spring-loaded mechanism in the rear hub controls the rear wheels, and there are no spokes or exposed bike chain. The 25-lb. aluminum trike won an international bike-design competition in Taiwan. Now its creators want to produce it commercially.

innovations.title: Personalized credit card
innovations.imageAlt: The Belgian KBC Bank lets customers add a photo to their bank cards
innovations.description: Wouldn't it be nice to show your personality whenever you shop?  KBC is the first Belgian bank offering you that possibility to be creative!  The process is a very user-friendly one.  Just up-load your favourite photo, maybe your family, your pet, a recent vacation, even yourself.  Position it and a few days later you can collect your personalized card at your local KBC agency.  This is another nice example of mass-customization and personalization of products/services.  CREAX had the honour of working together with KBC during the idea-generation of this concept.

innovations.title: Jointed speakers
innovations.imageAlt: This in-wall loudspeaker lies flush within the wall when not in use, and extends outward to evenly deliver surround effects throughout the entire room
innovations.description: The in-wall loudspeaker lies flush within the wall when not in use, and features a motorized, flat-panel, high frequency driver that automatically extends outward to evenly deliver surround effects throughout the entire room. The Ci FDT resembles other in-wall speakers at first glance, when activated, it becomes clear that this speaker's look and sound is unlike any other on the market. Because the proprietary flat-panel driver fully extends from the wall, it is able to envelope the entire audience with uniform surround sound effects. This results in a deep and stable soundstage that heightens the movie's realism for each listener, and makes the home theater's performance truly breathtaking.

innovations.title: Inflatable outdoor home theater
innovations.imageAlt: This inflatable outdoor theater system features big, weatherproof 8 foot screen that inflates in just four minutes with the powered air pump
innovations.description: The Inflatable outdoor home theatre screen recreates the drive-in experience in your own backyard. This inflatable outdoor theater system features big, weatherproof 8 foot screen that inflates in just four minutes with the powered air pump. The two weatherized outdoor amplified speakers with full range sound augment your home theater experience. Made from weatherproof PVC and two nylon rope tie-downs the screen wont move an inch even in strong winds. The theatre deflates as quicky as it inflates for easy storage and is compatible with most projectors.

innovations.title: Dog bowl prevents dog from eating too fast
innovations.imageAlt: Adding protrusions to a dog bowl create a barrier and prevent the dog from eating too quickly
innovations.description: The Brake-Fast Dog Food Bowl is an invention designed to slow down a dog from eating too fast. The three prongs sticking up from the bowl act as barriers to keep a dog from snatching up mouthfuls of dry or wet dog food. It's marketed as a way to help prevent Gastric Dilatation/Volvulus (GDV), when a dog's stomach distends with air to the point that it goes into shock and possibly dies.Interestingly, the bowl doesn't have a rubber base, and will slide across the floor. The manufacturer says this actually helps slow down the eating process.

innovations.title: Auto-guide
innovations.imageAlt: The AUTO-GUIDE Satellite Navigation System is a steer-assist feature that automatically guides the agriculture vehicle along a path established by GPS
innovations.description: The AUTO-GUIDE Satellite Navigation System is a steer-assist feature that automatically guides the agriculture vehicle along a path established by GPS (Global Positioning System). The system steers the vehicle electronically, so operator steering corrections are not required while the system is engaged.Auto-Guide uses sub-metre, decimetre and centimetre (USA only) accuracy to provide straight lines, while the operator is simply required to turn the machine at headlands.Operators are consequently less fatigued and work more efficiently into the night, or in low visibility situations, with reduced skips and overlaps - resulting in increased efficiency and economic savings.In addition, repeatability or Controlled Traffic eliminates guess rows and reduces widespread compaction, leading to environmental savings.

innovations.title: Seed tape
innovations.imageAlt: Seed tape has precisely spaced seeds in a tape that dissolves in water
innovations.description: Seed tape has precisely spaced seeds enclosed in an organic, water-soluble material. When planted, the tape dissolves and the seeds germinate normally. Seed tapes are especially convenient for tiny, hard-to-handle seeds. However, tapes are much more expensive per seed. Seed tapes allow uniform emergence of seedlings, eliminate overcrowding of seedlings and permit sowing in perfectly straight rows. The tapes can be cut at any point for multiple row plantings, and thinning is rarely necessary.

innovations.title: Circular printer
innovations.imageAlt: This circular printer uses rotational, instead of linear, movement to obtain a truly portable design and reducing the printer size
innovations.description: This circular-type portable concept printer responds to a real need for business travellers and challenges engineers to make it a reality. Using rotational, instead of linear, movement to obtain a truly portable design, printer size is reduced by one-third. The printer is light and compact. The design looks very slim, rounded lines impart an image of durability and portability.

innovations.title: Self-adapting shoes
innovations.imageAlt: Adidas has developed a running shoe that senses changes in surface conditions and running style and adjusts the amount of heel cushioning accordingly
innovations.description: Adidas has developed a running shoe that senses changes in surface conditions and running style and adjusts the amount of heel cushioning accordingly. Unlike articles of clothing that must be washed or cleaned, shoes present a more stable place to add useful electronics. The interface on the Adidas shoe consists of two buttons (one with a "+" and one with a "-") for adjusting the desired cushioning level. There's also a row of five tiny LEDs that indicates the current setting. IAdidas is planning on shipping the shoes with a CD-ROM to explain how to use them and change the batteries.

innovations.title: Cold metal spray
innovations.imageAlt: cold metal spray allows a thin layer of metal to be applied over almost any substrate
innovations.description:
The							patented cold-sprayable process allows a thin layer							of metal to be applied over almost any substrate, in							virtually any configuration or design. 
							LuminOre looks, feels, and acts like hot-cast metal,							because it is up to 95 percent metal. It will adhere							to almost any surface, including but not limited to;							foam, plastic, gypsum, wood, metal, fibreglass, plaster,							ceramics, concrete, terracotta, cardboard and even paper.							Once cured, the product has all the characteristics							of a cast metal piece, including texture, luster and							heat conductivity.

innovations.title: Toothbrush replacement service
innovations.imageAlt: A toothbrush replacement service delivering to your home
innovations.description: ToothbrushExpress is a unique toothbrush replacement servicedelivering to your home a new replacement toothbrush and other oralhealth care products on your preferred replacement schedule: monthly, bimonthly, quarterly or semi-annually.

innovations.title: Pizza Hut
innovations.imageAlt: Pizza Hut allows video game players to order a pizza during a game
innovations.description: You're in luck - pizza is just a few key strokes away! While playing EverQuest II just type /pizza and a web browser will launch the online ordering section of pizzahut.com. Fill in your info and just kick back until fresh pizza is delivered straight to your door.EverQuest II is the next generation of massively multiplayer gaming, a huge online world where thousands of players come together for adventure and community. Featuring breathtaking graphics and a vast, beautiful game world to explore, EverQuest II sets the standard for graphical realism as players are immersed in the game's exciting locales and dangerous lands.

innovations.title: "Zero-Detergent course" washing machine by Sanyo
innovations.imageAlt: Sanyo has developed a washing machine that uses ultrasonic waves instead of detergent to clean clothes
innovations.description: SANYO has now succeeded in implementing its Electrolyzed Water technology cultivated in SANYO's Water purifying bacteria-removing device into the Fully-Automatic "Wash with Ultrasonic Waves and Electrolysis" washing machine. By combining Electrolyzed Water's dirt dissolving and bacteria-removing properties with the cleansing power of Ultrasonic Wave technology SANYO has brought to realization the World's first "Zero-Detergent course" washing machine.

innovations.title: Shark skin inspires ship coating
innovations.imageAlt: A coating based on a sharks skin may increase ship speeds
innovations.description: A new environmentally friendly coating based on sharks' skin may soon help the U.S. Navy increase ship speeds while saving fuel. The coating doesn't go anywhere near the engines -- it will be applied on the hull of ships below the waterline, where all manner of algae, barnacles and other wee beasties attach themselves, slowing ships and reducing their manoeuvrability.

innovations.title: Transparent milk
innovations.imageAlt: This liquid looks and tastes a lot like water, but it contains the nutrients that are present in milk
innovations.description: DSM, who is active in the chemical industry, has succeeded to develop clear, transparent milk. The liquid looks and tastes a lot like water, but it contains the nutrients that are present in milk. Scientists have added some enzymes to milk through which the white colour disappears. The clear milk that arises from this treatment could be used as base for soft drinks. Seeing that children don't consider milk as sturdy, this way parents can make sure that their children drink enough milk.

innovations.title: 60-second charge battery
innovations.imageAlt: This battery can charge to 80 percent of its capacity in just 60 seconds
innovations.description: Toshiba's new Super Charge cells claims the new cell charge to 80 percent of its capacity in just 60 seconds and cap top out in just a few minutes more. Not only that, but after 1000 charge cycles, the lithium-ion cell loses only 1 percent of its charging capacity. Two of these cells and a nearby power outlet and you'll be able to stay mobile indefinitely. Toshiba's miracle battery aims initially at automotive and industrial applications. However, there's a clear benefit for mobile devices. Toshiba's prototype 600mAh cell, for example, was clearly developed with compact gadgets in mind: it measures 6.2 x 3.5 x 0.4cm.

innovations.title: Telescopic ladder
innovations.imageAlt: This telescopic ladder can extend to the required length and then collapse into itself for storage
innovations.description: The Xtend & Climb telescoping ladder compacts and stores in a bag that is a very manageable 30 inches (76 cm) by 19 inches (48 cm) by 3 inches (7.5 cm) and 25 pounds (11.3 kg) then miraculously transforms to a stable 12.5 feet (3.8 metre) ladder with a duty rating of 225 pounds (100 kilograms). Because Xtend & Climb opens and locks by the foot, you only need to open as many steps as you need. This makes the ladder ideal for inside work or outside work under the eaves. A traditional extension ladder is always going to be at least 8 feet long, making inside work difficult. Traditional extension ladders also frequently need to extend past the work height for the locking mechanism to work properly. The Xtend & Climb ladder locks into place at exactly the height it needs to reach and can be opened from the top or bottom.

innovations.title: Self seeking spray
innovations.imageAlt: Insect Seeking Technology uses statically charged droplets of spray to seek out flying insects and eliminate them quickly
innovations.description: Mortein Fly & Insect Killer with Insect Seeking Technology uses statically charged droplets of spray to seek out flying insects and eliminate them quickly; before they can spread disease or cause discomfort. The particles of spray are actually statically charged so that they are attracted to flying insects in the air!

innovations.title: TiO2 coating spray
innovations.imageAlt: This household spray kills bacteria and germs with room light
innovations.description: This coating spray claims to kill bacteria and germs with room light, to eliminate smells, to break up pollens causing allergy, to filter UV and to reduce formaldehyde in your room. The spray on the picture is designed for coating fabrics, so you can coat almost everything in your house. The coating last up to 30 times of machine washing. There is also a variant for glass and a paint variant.

innovations.title: Inhaled insuline
innovations.imageAlt: Insuline in a powdered form has the ability of being inhaled rather than injected
innovations.description: A device which allows people with diabetes to inhale, rather than inject, insulin. Tests carried out around the UK and in the US have shown that the device is as effective as conventional injections. However, they said inhaled insulin would not be suitable for everyone. The device, which would fit into a handbag, contains a blister pack of insulin in the form of dry powder. To release the powder, the user presses a button and inhales the powder. Anthony Barnett, professor of medicine at the University of Birmingham, who has been involved in the insulin inhaler research, said the device - which delivers short-acting insulin - could cut the number of injections people with Type 1 diabetes need to just one or two. The researchers have also looked at people with Type 2 diabetes, which usually develops in adulthood and can often be controlled with diet and medicines. They said inhaled insulin appeared to give better blood glucose control than taking tablets.

innovations.title: Double airbag
innovations.imageAlt: Toyota has developed a new dual airbag system to reduce injury which distributes the impact over the side of you face
innovations.description: Airbags hurt. Toyota has developed a new airbag system to reduce injury. Instead of a single airbag, the new technology uses two bags to distribute the impact over the sides of your face and shoulders while still supporting your head. It will debut in new Lexus models.

innovations.title: Door handles add feedback
innovations.imageAlt: These door handles change from green to red when the room is occupied
innovations.description: Designed by Alexander Lervik, the Brighthandle communicates with coloured light. The Alfa Online model changes its light from Green to Red when the room is occupied (activated by the thumb turn). The Alfa is wired to an electrical outlet through the door, and is available with a matching Brighthandle Zero handle in stainless steel or with an identical handle. In comparison, the Alfa Battery model shows no light when the room is vacant but signals Red when occupied. It uses two R6 batteries. The Brighthandle will be handy on a bathroom or toilet door.

innovations.title: Camera with cropping technique
innovations.imageAlt: This camera allows the photographer to take a picture at any aspect ratio
innovations.description: Digital technology is supposed to make taking pictures easier, but today's cameras have a dizzying array of features most will never use. The ability to take an unlimited number of pictures at no cost has negated our respect for an image's composure. With a finite amount of memory and an unlimited number of shooting configurations, a.Pix makes taking pictures simple and thought provoking actions, a.Pix makes taking pictures simple and thought provoking.

innovations.title: Wind-up bedside lamp
innovations.imageAlt: Wind-up to turn the light on before you go to bed and the light will stay on until the key winds back
innovations.description: People who read in the bed sometimes forget to turn off the light. The key from this wind-up bedside lamp functions as a switch and a timer. Wind-up to turn the light on before you go to bed. The light will stay on until the key winds back. Its main source of power comes from its powerful spring-driven generator. As the high carbon tensile steel spring unwinds, power is transferred to a small dynamo electric generator which produces enough electricity to power of the light.

innovations.title: Zippable bag
innovations.imageAlt: The zippable bag can be unzipped and laid flat for easy storage and cleaning
innovations.description: When unzipped, this bag lays completely flat for dry cleaning and easy storage. When zipped, it becomes an interesting form with unlimited functionality. Constructed of pressed industrial felt made from factory excess material. Comprised of approximately 85% wool and 15% mixed fibers.

innovations.title: Foldable bank card
innovations.imageAlt: This bank card can be folded in half and kept on your keys
innovations.description: American Express introduced their new Butterfly card, a foldable card and keychain carrier available to all of their Gold Card holders. The concept is to make taking (and therefore using) your card as convenient as possible. Since most people use some sort of key chain it's a logical choice to design around. The card can be handled like a standard card, left halfway in the case with the magnetic strip exposed, or folded up in the case and slipped easily in your pocket, purse or on your key chain.

innovations.title: Childrens toothbrush that lights up
innovations.imageAlt: This childrens toothbrush that lights up for 60 seconds when grabbed
innovations.description: The Float'n Firefly lights up for 60 seconds, a recommended amount of time to keep brushing for a good cleaning. Parent's challenge has been figuring out how to keep them brushing long enough. This toothbrush promises to put an end to that battle. Comes in an assortment of colors with different toy figures/characters, too.

innovations.title: Robotic surface membrane
innovations.imageAlt: This transformable architectural surface can adapt to changing spatial and environmental needs
innovations.description: This prototype is representative of an approach to develop transformable architectural surfaces. In an attempt to develop surface-systems with malleable qualities of textile, this prototype was developed using pneumatic actuators over flat triangular surface-tiles. Transformable membranes could intelligently adapt to changing spatial and environmental needs by undergoing shape transformation. The system presented involves embedded computation techniques including sensing, interaction and , ANN based control automation to induce transformative capacities within architectural surfaces.

innovations.title: Saw stop
innovations.imageAlt: The SawStop is equipped with a safety system that detects when someone accidentally contacts the spinning saw blade, and then stops the blade in milliseconds
innovations.description: SawStop Saws are the most advanced saws in the world. Each saw is equipped with a safety system that detects when someone accidentally contacts the spinning saw blade, and then stops the blade in milliseconds. In most cases, such an accident would result in just a nick on a SawStop saw, instead of the devastating injury which would likely occur on an ordinary saw. The SawStop safety system includes an electronic detection system that detects when a person contacts the blade. The system induces an electrical signal onto the blade and then monitors that signal for changes. The human body has a relatively large inherent electrical capacitance and conductivity which cause the signal to drop when a person contacts the blade. Wood has a relatively small inherent capacitance and conductivity and does not cause the signal to drop.

innovations.title: Swiss knife seating unit
innovations.imageAlt: This sofa is inspired by a swiss army knife with sections that can be rotated
innovations.description: This sofa is inspired by Swiss Army Knives; its many sections swing around 360 degrees, creating many different configurations depending on whether you're having a quiet evening with the console or throwing a party

innovations.title: Modular coffin
innovations.imageAlt: This low-cost coffin is easy to assembly; the parts just click together
innovations.description: EveryBody Special is a new, low-cost wooden coffin created to meet extreme demand during emergency situations. This modular coffin is extremely easy to assemble. No tools, nails or screws are required – the pieces just click together. The standard material used is 12 mm plywood, and more environmentally friendly options are also available. Since they're lightweight and packaged in flat-packs (Ikea-style), transporting EveryBody coffins is very cost efficient: up to 570 extra large caskets fit into a 20 foot container. Combined with their easy assembly, this makes the coffins highly suitable for burial and cremation in disaster areas and epidemic situations. The company hopes to offer a more dignified, humane alternative to plastic body bags that are often the only option when large-scale disaster strikes.

innovations.title: Bolts with colour indicator
innovations.imageAlt: This bolt has a simple indicator inside the head that changes colour when it is tightened
innovations.description: This bolt has a simple indicator inside the head that changes colour when it is tightened. It is used in industrial equipment so you can see if a bolt is coming loose. Someone should create a luggage concept using the same indicator as a weight sensor so you know if your luggage is too heavy for the airline's baggage check.

innovations.title: Self-repairing material
innovations.imageAlt: The silicone layer in this innovative material can repair itself
innovations.description: A german outdoor sports brand is now using a polyamide material with a silicon layer in a few of their products. That not only makes the material water-resistant but if there is a hole in the backpack, the silicone layer will try and repair itself back into its original form. There are however limits to this: only holes of a few millimeters large will be repaired in a few minutes.The material is used in a few of there superlight backpacks and tents.

innovations.title: Outdoor surface spray
innovations.imageAlt: This outdoor surface cleaner has a hose attachment for easier outdoor use
innovations.description: Carolin Outdoor Surface Cleaner is specially designed to clean outdoor household surfaces including terraces, walls, shutter, and garden furniture. The biodegradable formula is especially formulated for use outdoors. The product can be used with a hose attachment or diluted in a bucket.

innovations.title: Transparent canoe/kayak
innovations.imageAlt: A transparent canoe offers the paddlers an underwater view
innovations.description: This kayak/canoe hybrid has a transparent polymer hull that offers paddlers an underwater vista of aquatic wildlife and waterscapes unavailable in conventional boats. Seating two people, the sturdy canoe hull is made of the same durable material found in the cockpit canopies of supersonic fighter jets. With a lightweight anodized aluminum frame, it can be easily stored or transported to and from the water.

innovations.title: Collapsible container
innovations.imageAlt: These adjustable container can collapse and flatten and then expand to store food
innovations.description: You want a container and you don't want a container. These adjustable containers from Tupperware collapse and flatten to about 1 inch, then expand to keep foods fresh at home or on the go. The 3-cup containers adjust to a 2 1/4 or 1 1/4-cup container for smaller capacities. The FlatOut containers can be filled with a variety of foods.

innovations.title: Condensed milk
innovations.imageAlt: condensed milk
innovations.description: Condensed milk is cow's milk from which water has been removed and to which sugar has been added, yielding a very thick, sweet product that can last on the shelf for years.

innovations.imageAlt: egg in the shape of a line

The shape of an egg doesn't need to be oval. Changing the shape to aline makes in easier to slice the egg in even pieces.
The SANOVO 6-32 became known as the long eggmachine. The machine, which produced egg pieces that were app. 20 cmlong with a regular centre of yolk surrounded by egg white of an eventhickness, was a sensation at its first exhibition in 
London
 in 1974. The concept behind the long egg was simple, but thedevelopment of the machine required considerable time and resources.

innovations.title: Instant hot beverages
innovations.imageAlt: Just shake the cup and the coffee becomes warm
innovations.description: They already have chemical products that instantly generate heat when properly agitated, largely used for physical therapy -- now it's just a matter of combining that chemistry with beverages like coffee, hot chocolate or whatever. I suppose the key is in the packaging -- making sure the product is easy to agitate and that the chemicals are always kept separate from the beverage. Assuming you could get over that, it sure would be nice to have on hand in case you get caught outside somewhere cold -- don't have to make a fire, just agitate and enjoy a nice cup of cocoa...

innovations.title: Spray on bandage
innovations.imageAlt: This spray on bandage is easier to apply to minor cuts and scrapes
innovations.description: Hansaplast Spray Bandage is the convenient way of taking care of minor cuts and scrapes. The transparent breathable film seals out water, dirt and germs for maximum protection.

innovations.title: Sugar cubes with aroma
innovations.imageAlt: Adding flavours to sugar will bring a new coffee experience
innovations.description: Douwe Egberts has introduced Momenti, aromatised sugar cubes which are claimed to have a "surprising" taste. They are for use in coffee and are available in four different flavours, comprising of: Irish Cream; Amaretto; Praline; and Chocolate. It is made in collaboration with Tienen / Tirlemont.

innovations.title: Spray on stocking
innovations.imageAlt: Micro-fine silk powder can be used in a spray on stocking
innovations.description: 1. Clothe easily with any color as you like.2. Comprises micro-fine silk particles, can hides scars and spots perfectly, and makes your legs fine and smooth.3. Perfect for open-toe, free from bondage, all make you feel at ease. 4. It is a water-proof type, be very strong in the sweat and rain.5. It is run-proof, but does not get tight.6. Protects the skin from UV-A and UV-B ray related damage.7. With effect of refreshing and ventilate, show your legs more naturally.

innovations.title: Liquid bandage
innovations.imageAlt: The liquid bandage is a non-solvent-based, non-sting liquid bandage that can be applied on all minor cuts and scrapes even in those hard to reach areas
innovations.description: Compeed Liquid Bandage: Invisible, flexible, breathable protection Compeed® Liquid Bandage is a non-solvent-based, non-sting liquid bandage that can be applied on all minor cuts and scrapes even in those hard to reach areas.Liquid Bandage is 100% waterproof, sealing out water, dirt and germs to help prevent infection and provides healing on contact faster than conventional plasters.Compeed Liquid Bandage provides instant pain relief and is appropriate for minor wound, lacerations, abrasions and skin cracks. Also great for friction blisters, shaving cuts, hangnails, finger cracks and paper cuts. It stays on for days and sloughs off naturally.

innovations.description: As thin asmasking tape, the magnetic power is strong enough to hold paper to anyacceptable surface.Colourful and convenient, Xyron's line of adhesive dispensers snaptogether to create one station,

innovations.title: Releasable lashing ties
innovations.imageAlt: Reuseable cable ties are useful when changes are anticipated during development
innovations.description: Lashing Ties are typically used on heavy duty jobs such as securing conduit or large cable bundles to permanent structures indoors or out. The extended tab end of releasable cable ties permits easy release and reuse even after the tie has been pulled up snug by hand. Releasable ties are particularly useful where changes are anticipated during development, production or servicing in the field.

innovations.title: Chip delivers better digital pictures for less power
innovations.imageAlt: The team of Mark Bocko, has designed an imaging chip that can use just a fraction of the energy used today and capture better images
innovations.description: Imaging chips revolutionized the photography industry, and now the chips themselves are being revolutionized. A pair of newly patented technologies may soon enable power-hungry imaging chips to use just a fraction of the energy used today and capture better images to boot - all the while enabling cameras to shrink to the size of a shirt button and run for years on a single battery. Placed in a home, they could wirelessly provide images to a security company when an alarm is tripped, or even allow mapping software like Google's to zoom in to real-time images at street level. The enormous reduction in power consumption and increase in computing power can also bring cell-phone video calls closer to fruition.The team of Mark Bocko, professor of electrical and computer engineering, and Zeljko Ignjatovic, assistant professor of electrical and computer engineering, has designed a prototype chip that can digitize an image right at each pixel, and they are working now to incorporate a second technology that will compress the image with far fewer computations than the best current compression techniques.

innovations.title: Chocolate bar
innovations.imageAlt: A regular chocolate bar with added grooves in its surface, makes it easier to break a piece off
innovations.description: Breaking pieces of chocolate off a slab can be made easier by adding grooves to the surface. This creates a a deliberate weak point in the chocolate slab.

innovations.title: Counteract balancing beads
innovations.imageAlt: The Counterbalance Beads will automatically balance the complete wheel assembly
innovations.description: The Counteract or Counterbalance Beads will automatically balance the complete wheel assembly.Simply open the outside package, and toss the inner bag into the tire. This method allows the use of an air blaster to seat the tire on the rim, without contaminating the seating area. The air blaster pressure inside the tire will collapse the bag containing the Beads or it will break soon after installation.

innovations.title: Clean and Protect plaster
innovations.imageAlt: 2-in1 plaster that combines cleansing and protection of minor wounds in one single unit
innovations.description: Clean & Protect is the perfect 2in1-solution at home as well as on the way. It combines cleansing and protection of minor wounds in one single unit. The two-part foil contains an antiseptic wipe on the one side which cleans and disinfects the wound. While the plaster on the other side covers and protects the wound. Due to its small size it fits in every bag and is extremely convenient to use.

innovations.description: These magnets are constructed of permanently magnetic special materials calibrated for use in a washing machine.The average home contains 25 gallons of hazardous chemicals including formaldehyde, phenolic and chlorine compounds, all found in detergents.Many ads for detergent talk about the clean smell of the clothes after using their detergent.  A perfume smell.   Clean clothes DO NOT smell like perfume... perfume smells like perfume.  Clean clothes have no odor at all.

innovations.title: 5-in-1 survival tool
innovations.imageAlt: This survival tools include a retractable whistle, compass, thermometer and powerful LED flashlight
innovations.description: The Zelco LifeAid Sport and Westminster LifeRing, designed by Prime Studio, New York:  The 5-in-1 survival tools include a retractable, shrill whistle, liquid-dampened compass, sealed thermometer and powerful LED flashlight with optional strobe feature to allow you to signal to others. The Zelco version offers a dual-beam flashlight and waterproof rubber finish.

innovations.title: Modular seating system
innovations.imageAlt: This modular seating system comprised of bar and l-shaped components, can be modified to the user needs
innovations.description: Cocoon Branding is a Canadian multidisciplinary design firm with a central focus on bold brand concepts and innovations. The Winnipeg-based company has  launched Oi, an ultra-modular seating/surface system. Oi (a lax way to say "hello" in many languages) is comprised of bar and L-shaped seating components, glass surfaces, and a linking base that can expand and minimize to accommodate any space. The seating components slip snugly onto the base and create flat surfaces, extensions, backrests and armrests. The entire system compacts neatly to save space for shipping and storage, whereas traditional sofas and chairs must be transported and stored as one entire piece. Cocoon seriously took sustainability into consideration, utilizing materials such as recyclable aluminum and steel, recycled/recyclable plastic, recycled/recyclable glass, and Eco-leather.

innovations.title: Tyre with individual "balls"
innovations.imageAlt: Individual air cells in a tyre will prevent a complete flat tyre when punctured
innovations.description: The pneumatic tyre has a massive Achilles heel: lose the air and it stops the vehicle. The most-read story in the history of this fine publication is about Michelin's Tweel, the first viable alternative to the pneumatic tyre in more than a century with its greatest asset being that it doesn't go flat. Now there's another flat-proof inflation system based on individual balls or air cells that has evolved from motorcycle off-road racing, where to win, you need to be able to finish the race. Tyre Ball not only offers virtual flat-proof characteristics but simultaneously improves traction and improves suspension performance. In addition to racing, the Tyre Ball is also a natural for agricultural, commercial and military applications where a flat might cost you a whole lot more than time.It works like this - balls (air-cells) replace the vulnerable inner tube or tube-less inflation system. The system is designed to retrofit to conventional tyres and wheels and is lighter and more durable than foam inserts. Each individual Tyre Ball cell is made from materials that are claimed to be ten times more puncture resistant than conventional heavy-duty neoprene tubes. Punctures are still possible, but very rare. Instead of losing all the air in your tyre, only one cell goes flat, allowing you to finish the ride without needing to lose countless places in a race, or spend 20 minutes fixing a flat in the middle of the woods.

innovations.title: Inflatable and portable chair
innovations.imageAlt: This inflatable, portable, water-resistant chair can be taken with you anywhere
innovations.description: Dutch design studio PSLab's chAIRbag is a new inflatable, portable, water-resistant chair that you can tote anywhere in case you need to rest. The rotational molded PVC seat is modeled after the friendly shape of a bean-bag chair with the convenience of easy stain and spillage removal. chAIRbag is offered in a variety of colors and is suitable for both indoor and outdoor use. The "aroma" factor is another add-on feature, currently only available in a vanilla scent.

innovations.title: Soft poles absorb the energy of a crash
innovations.imageAlt: Soft Poles are energy absorbing columns that reduce the impact of the crash for the passengers and avoid the risk of a second collision
innovations.description: Soft Poles are energy absorbing columns. They reduce the impact of the crash for the passengers and avoid the risk of a second collision.In case of a collision, the yielding of the soft pole slows the speed of the colliding car down.The controlled speed reduction softens the impact. The energy of the mass of the vehicle and the speed of the car get transformed into the deformation of the pole. The strong conical shape of the pole changes into a soft ribbonThe impact of the pole on the colliding vehicle is limited in that way so the passenger cage stays in shape. The risk for injuries stays limited.

innovations.title: Liquid shoe polish
innovations.imageAlt: liquid shoe polish for quicker and better coverage of the shoe
innovations.description: Liquid shoe polish is easier to apply to shoes. It also dries much quicker than ordinary shoe polish.

innovations.title: Underwater epoxy
innovations.imageAlt: An epoxy that can be used underwater
innovations.description: A small number of two-part epoxy coatings have the unique feature of being able to be applied underwater. Common			applications include coating piers, pilings, pools, tanks, etc. In many areas			of the globe, humidity levels are often well above 75% nearly all of the time. With such high moisture levels,			most dry surface paints will have a much reduced surface bond which can result in premature blistering or coating			failure. Simply put, moisture, in whatever form, is a primary reason for coating problems. Underwater (i.e. wet			surface) epoxies avoid this area of concern. These epoxies can, of course, be used on dry surfaces much like any			other coating. Besides those already mentioned, other places you are likely to find underwater epoxies include			the inside and outside of ships, inside manholes, on cooling towers, piers and pilings, and tanks, pits and sumps			of all kinds, as well as on floors with vapor transmission problems.

innovations.title: Magnetic paint
innovations.imageAlt: Magnetic paint contains iron dust and will attract magnets
innovations.description: Magnetic Paint turns any paintable surface into a magnetic playland. Infused with iron dust, this magnetic paint is a gray latex paint that works as a primer that attracts magnets (the paint is not itself a magnet, it attracts magnets). It is child safe and non toxic, and is completely safe to use near computers, since the paint attracts magnets but is not itself a magnet.

innovations.title: Razor with micro-pulses
innovations.imageAlt: This razor that uses micro-pulses to stimulate hair up and away from skin
innovations.description: The first Micro-Powered Shaving System from Gillette, for a totally new shaving experience and Gillette's best shave ever. Micro-Power: Gentle micro-pulses stimulate hair up and away from skin. In just one power stroke, you can get a closer and more thorough shave. So thorough, there is less need to reshave, which means less irritation. New PowerGlide Blades: Patented blade coating produces Gillette's smoothest blade surface for incredible glide - and a level of comfort that only M3POWER can give. Indicator Lubrastrip with Vitamin E and Aloe. Features: motor, on/off button, replaceable AAA battery included. Shower safe.

innovations.title: Toothbrush with pulsating action
innovations.imageAlt: Pulsating action in an electric toothbrush helps reduce plaque more efficiently than a manual toothbrush
innovations.description: The Oral-B ProfessionalCare® 7000 Series features the most advanced power toothbrush we ever created - the only one to combine a compact round brushhead with a unique pulsing 3D action to help prevent and even reverse gum disease. The combination of high speed pulsations and the oscillating rotating technology pioneered by Oral-B has been shown to reduce plaque and gingivitis more effectively than a manual toothbrush

innovations.title: Dryer with moisture sensor
innovations.imageAlt: A sensor in a dryer detects when the clothes are dry and then turns the dryer off
innovations.description: Different dryer models do vary in the amount of energy they use, but new dryers have many feature options which allow you to use less energy. One of the new energy-saving features is an automatic moisture sensor. These sensors measure the amount of moisture in clothes; and when they're dry the machine shuts off.

innovations.title: Street lights with light measurement
innovations.imageAlt: Street lights with a sensors to measure the amount of light will turn on or off depending on the amount of light
innovations.description: Sensors in street light are able to measur the amount of incoming sunlight. When the surrounding light becomes insuffiecient the lights will turn on automatically. The opposite happens in the morning when the sensor detects enough light. The lights are then turned off.

innovations.title: Solar powered street lights
innovations.imageAlt: Solar energy can also be use to power street lights
innovations.description: Solar-powered streetlights can illuminate walking paths, parks or other areas without connection to power lines. In addition to operating totally independently of electricity distribution systems, solar-powered streetlights provide a visible demonstration of the effectiveness of solar energy in meeting energy requirements for lighting in outdoor public areas.In the case of a storm, the streetlights can still provide light if there is no electricity.

innovations.title: Duracell power check
innovations.imageAlt: Duracell batteries have a built-in battery tester which measures remaining battery power
innovations.description: DURACELL PowerCheck Batteries allow consumers to conveniently test battery power anytime, anywhere. DURACELL PowerCheck Batteries have an on-battery fuel-gauge tester which measures remaining battery power. By simply pressing the dots on the side and bottom edge of the battery, a display on the side of the battery reveals an easy-to-read graduated measure of remaining battery power.

innovations.title: Diet chocolate
innovations.imageAlt: Diet chocolate enriched with mushroom chitosa helps prevent the absorbtion of fat and helps the expulsion precess
innovations.description: Recently a number of functional chocolates have been launched, with benefits that range from heart health (through the use of soy isoflavones or Omega-3) to more general health and beauty claims (with polyphenols and anti-oxidants). Now, it appears functional chocolates are becoming even more advanced. In Japan, Oacac introduced Choco Lady, a range of chocolate pellets, which actually claim to actively help slimming by suppressing the absorption of fat. These small pellets of chocolate have crispy biscuit centres and are enriched with mushroom chitosan, a polysaccharide said to prevent the absorption of fat and help aid its expulsion from the body. For maximum effect, the consumer should eat five pellets before each meal, and the product is available in a seven-day or a thirty-day pack. This product is interesting as it works like a regular supplement, with the advantage of being a nice sweet treat, usually out of bounds for consumers trying to lose weight.

innovations.title: Digiscents iSmell
innovations.imageAlt: The iSmell device connected to a PC can produce thousands of everyday smells
innovations.description: In Oakland, Calif., DigiScents, Inc. is developing a digital scent device, called the iSmell. They are fully aware of how people will respond to the device's tongue-in-cheek name. The iSmell can create thousands of everyday scents with a small cartridge that contains 128 primary odors. These primary odors are mixed together to generate other smells that closely replicate common natural and manmade odors. The scent cartridge, like a printer's toner cartridge, will have to be replaced periodically to maintain the scent accuracy.

innovations.title: FiveFingers shoes
innovations.imageAlt: These shoes have a barefoot design, giving the wearer a feel of walking barefoor
innovations.description: The FiveFingers shoes not only hug the feet, but also separate the toes into their own little shoes. Not only are your feet protected, but the barefoot design adds an element of exercise that regular shoes don't provide. On the back of the shoe is a convenient pull tab and elastic lock that lets you customize the fit, just like triathalon laces. Its patent-pending design provided greater dexterity, improving agility, balance and control.

innovations.title: Temperature-sensitive baby spoons
innovations.imageAlt: A temperature sensitive area on a baby spoon helps show parents if the food is too hot
innovations.description: This soft babyspoon has a temperature sensitive area which indicates how hot the food is. This helps parents in judging the food temperature before feeding the child. The area in the spoon will turn white if the food is too hot.

innovations.title: Jupiler Blue
innovations.imageAlt: Belgian beer, Jupiler, has a blue ice crystal label that shows when the the beer has the perfect temperature
innovations.description: The back label has an interesting feature: The upper right corner of the back label shows a blue ice crystal, but only when the bottle has the right 3°C temperature.The perfect t° to pour out this low alkoholic pilsener.

innovations.title: Shredding scissors
innovations.imageAlt: These shredding scissors have 5 blades
innovations.description: The shredding scissors have 5 identical blades alongside each other. This is a cheaper alternative to a paper shredder.

innovations.title: Multi angle nail clipper
innovations.imageAlt: This three way clipper gives users options for how they hold the clippers and their fingers while clipping the nails
innovations.description: This three way clipper gives users options for how they hold the clippers and their fingers while clipping the nails.  This is great for those with Arthritis, tremors, Parkinson's or any condition that weakens the hands. If you have disabled hands, it is difficult to clip your finger nails. Part of the challenge is simply the difficulty in positioning the tools and your fingers in a position where you can squeeze the clippers.

innovations.title: No-slide car clothes rack
innovations.imageAlt: The no-skid surface on a car-clothes rack prevents clothing from sliding around
innovations.description: Car Clothes Bar for bringing dry cleaning home wrinkle-free. Attaches to grab bars in back of car and lets you neatly hang clothes on hangers to preserve their condition. Features no-skid cover that prevents hangers from moving.

innovations.title: Ferrofluids
innovations.imageAlt: Ferrofluids are made from microscopic iron particles and react to magnetic fields
innovations.description: Ferrofluids look like pitch-black ink. Developed for the U.S. space program, ferrofluids are made from super small iron particles, only about ten nanometers in diameter and the size of a single molecule. Given a chemical coating, or surfactant, that prevents them from clumping together, the particles are added to oil or water, making a liquid that responds to magnets. Ferrofluids already have been put to work inside loudspeakers, where they help keep the inner parts cool. They also are vital to computer hard drives and semiconductor manufacturing, where they act as seals, keeping out dust and other contaminants. Nanotechnologists want to harness ferrofluids to help operate tiny new sensors or actuators, moving parts that can be controlled electrically. Ferrofluids made with water also could be useful inside the body, as part of tiny pumps or other biomedical devices. In the Laboratory for Electronic and Electromagnetic Systems at Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT), electrical engineer Markus Zahn and his research team are exploring ferrofluids potential in nanoscale motors and biomedical devices. All the current uses of ferrofluids involve their responding to permanent magnetic fields, fields that remain constant and don't change over time.
innovations.function: add a new function or integrate another function

innovations.title: Aerogel - lightest solid
innovations.imageAlt: Aerogel is a silicone based solid compossed of individual features only a few nanometers in size linked in a highly porous structure
innovations.description: Aerogel is 99.8% air and 1,000 times less dense than glass yet it can withstand high temperature, is robust enough to survive a space launch and delivers 39 times more insulation than the best fibreglass. This exotic substance was invented in the 1930s but recently refined by NASA for the purpose of catching space-dust, Aerogel was used on the Mars Pathfinder rover and its latest assignment is to capture both cometary samples and interstellar particles aboard the Stardust mission. Although much less dense than glass, Aerogel is another silicon-based solid but is composed of individual features only a few nanometers in size linked in a highly porous structure. Its unusual properties include low thermal conductivity, refractive index and sound speed - but it's the ability to slow down and capture fast moving dust with minimal heating or other effects that would cause their physical alteration that grabbed NASA's attention.
